description: Fictional September 2026 syndication cases: each case lists copies of one wire story carried by different outlets that must cluster together; distractors are different stories on similar topics that must not join the case named in about_case.

cases.note: Reuters original, Nasdaq copy with 'Apple Inc', '$2 bln' and ' | Nasdaq' suffix, Yahoo copy with ' (Reuters)' suffix, Google News style copy with ' - Investing.com' title suffix whose summary is just the title plus source, as in Google News RSS.

copies.headline: Apple to buy AI startup Lumora Labs for $2 billion
copies.summary: Apple Inc has agreed to acquire Lumora Labs, a San Francisco-based developer of on-device AI search tools, for about $2 billion, the company said on Tuesday, as it accelerates its push into generative AI.

copies.headline: Apple to buy AI startup Lumora Labs for $2 billion - Investing.com
copies.summary: Apple to buy AI startup Lumora Labs for $2 billion  Investing.com

cases.note: 'UPDATE 1-' wire prefix, 'Nvidia Corp' vs 'Nvidia', 'bln' vs 'billion' in summary, ' - Reuters' suffix.

copies.headline: Nvidia raises quarterly revenue forecast on strong AI chip demand
copies.summary: Nvidia on Monday raised its fiscal third-quarter revenue forecast to about $58 billion from $54 billion, citing stronger-than-expected orders for its Blackwell data-center systems from cloud providers.

copies.headline: SAP to cut 3,000 jobs, or 3% of workforce, in restructuring
copies.summary: German software maker SAP plans to cut about 3,000 jobs, or 3% of its workforce, and book restructuring charges of up to 800 million euros as it shifts investment toward business AI, the company said on Wednesday.

copies.headline: Novo Nordisk cuts 2026 sales outlook as Wegovy demand slows
copies.summary: Novo Nordisk on Tuesday cut its full-year sales growth forecast to 4%-8% from 8%-14%, a reduction of roughly DKK 12 billion in expected revenue, as US demand for its Wegovy obesity drug slowed.

copies.headline: EU fines Microsoft 1.1 bln euros over Teams bundling
copies.summary: EU antitrust regulators fined Microsoft 1.1 bln euros on Thursday for illegally tying its Teams video-conferencing app to its Office suite, the European Commission said.

copies.summary: The Federal Reserve cut its key interest rate by a quarter point on Wednesday to a range of 3.25% to 3.5% and signaled that it expects to reduce rates once more before the end of the year.

copies.headline: Microsoft raises quarterly dividend 10%, announces new $60 billion buyback
copies.summary: Microsoft Corp on Tuesday raised its quarterly dividend by 10% to 91 cents per share and announced a new share repurchase program of up to $60 billion, with no expiration date.

cases.note: 'Lilly' vs 'Eli Lilly' vs 'Eli Lilly and Co', '14%' vs '14 pct', ' | Nasdaq' suffix.

copies.headline: Lilly's obesity pill helps patients lose 14% of weight in late-stage trial
copies.summary: Eli Lilly said on Sunday its experimental once-daily obesity pill helped patients lose an average of 14% of their body weight over 72 weeks in a late-stage trial, putting it on track for a US filing by year-end.

copies.headline: Eli Lilly and Co's obesity pill helps patients lose 14 pct of weight in late-stage trial | Nasdaq
copies.summary: Eli Lilly said on Sunday its experimental once-daily obesity pill helped patients lose an average of 14 pct of their body weight over 72 weeks in a late-stage trial, putting it on track for a US filing by year-end.

cases.note: Identical summaries; 'EXCLUSIVE-' prefix on the wire copy, 'licence' vs 'license' spelling, ' (Reuters)' suffix.

copies.headline: EXCLUSIVE-Nvidia wins US licence to ship advanced AI chips to Saudi Arabia
copies.summary: The US Commerce Department has granted Nvidia a licence to ship tens of thousands of its most advanced AI chips to Saudi Arabia, according to documents seen by Reuters, clearing the way for large data-centre projects in the kingdom.

copies.headline: Nvidia wins US license to ship advanced AI chips to Saudi Arabia

distractors.headline: What Apple's $2 billion Lumora deal means for investors
distractors.summary: The Lumora acquisition is small relative to Apple's cash pile, but it signals a shift toward buying AI talent. We look at valuation impact, integration risk and what it means for the services margin.

distractors.headline: Apple to buy AI chip startup Voltera for $400 million
distractors.summary: Apple agreed to acquire Voltera, a Toronto-based designer of low-power AI inference chips, for about $400 million, a second AI deal in the same week as it builds out in-house silicon.

distractors.headline: AMD raises quarterly revenue forecast on strong AI chip demand
distractors.summary: Advanced Micro Devices on Monday lifted its third-quarter revenue forecast to about $9.8 billion from $9.2 billion, saying demand for its Instinct accelerators had exceeded its expectations.

distractors.headline: Workday to cut 1,750 jobs in restructuring
distractors.summary: Workday plans to eliminate about 1,750 positions, or 8% of its workforce, and close some offices as the HR software maker reallocates spending toward AI products.

distractors.headline: Novo Nordisk cuts Wegovy US list price by 20%
distractors.summary: Novo Nordisk will lower the US list price of its Wegovy injection by 20% starting in January, the company said, as it tries to expand insurance coverage for the obesity drug.

distractors.headline: EU fines Amazon 900 mln euros over marketplace data use
distractors.summary: EU antitrust regulators fined Amazon 900 million euros on Thursday for using non-public data from independent sellers to favour its own retail business on its marketplace.

distractors.headline: TSMC August revenue rises 34% on AI chip orders
distractors.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co reported August revenue of T$342 billion, up 34% from a year earlier, driven by strong orders for advanced AI processors.

distractors.headline: Fed governor says more rate cuts may be needed this year
distractors.summary: A Federal Reserve governor said a day after the central bank's decision that a softening labor market could justify additional easing beyond what officials projected.

distractors.headline: European Central Bank keeps key interest rate on hold, signals no rush to cut
distractors.summary: The European Central Bank left its benchmark deposit rate unchanged at 2% on Thursday, saying inflation in the 20 countries that use the euro is close to its target.

distractors.headline: Microsoft raises Microsoft 365 prices by 10% for business customers
distractors.summary: Microsoft will increase prices for its Microsoft 365 business and enterprise plans by about 10% from January, citing the addition of Copilot features to the standard subscriptions.

distractors.headline: Eli Lilly's obesity pill: analysts see $20 billion peak sales
distractors.summary: After Sunday's trial readout, analysts raised peak sales estimates for Lilly's oral obesity drug to as much as $20 billion, while flagging manufacturing scale and pricing as open questions.

distractors.headline: Nvidia wins order to supply AI chips to Saudi data-center operator
distractors.summary: A Saudi data-center developer said it has placed an order for 18,000 Nvidia Blackwell processors for a facility near Riyadh due to open in 2027, without disclosing the order's value.
